newsitem.title: FINLAND: POLAR FALLS TO YEAR-LOW ON PROFIT-WARNING.
newsitem.headline: POLAR FALLS TO YEAR-LOW ON PROFIT-WARNING.

text.p: Shares in Finnish construction group Polar-Yhtyma Oy fell sharply on Wednesday after the company said its 1997 operating profit would not improve on 1996 as it had earlier stated, brokers said.
At 1430/1130 GMT, Polar traded at year-low of 6.60 markka, down 0.55 markka or almost eight percent. Turnover was thin at 636,000 markka.
Polar said its building operations would incur a slight operating loss in the early part of the year.
The company had said in February with its full-year 1996 results that it expected its operating profit to improve this year.
"This is actually surprising -- since everyone has been talking about overheating in the building sector," one broker said.
